newsitem.title: UK: GKN extend decline after negative comment.
newsitem.headline: GKN extend decline after negative comment.

text.p: Shares in GKN Plc fell in early trading on Friday, extending yesterday's decline after negative press comment on yesterday's $398 million U.S. court award against a U.S. unit of the UK engineering group.

The stock was down 5-1/2p at 10.03-1/2 stg by 0824 GMT, after yesterday dropping 35-1/2p, despite an early surge in the rest of the UK market after the Dow yesterday posted its second biggest ever rise in point terms.
The Financial Times Lex column said GKN faced hefty losses if the award is upheld on appeal, damaging its ability to make potentially value-adding acquisitions.

It said yesterday's 3.4 percent decline possibily underestimated the scale of the problem. "Unless investors hope the judgement will be reversed or diminished, a bigger drop in the shares would be appropriate," the paper said.
